items.citation_text: Government of Ontario, Ministry of Health; corroborated by the supervisor's final report, CBC News, and Mackenzie Health
items.verbatim_snippet: The Lieutenant Governor in Council appointed Altaf Stationwala as supervisor of Renfrew Victoria Hospital under subsection 9(1) of the Public Hospitals Act, following the Minister of Health’s recommendation and a determination that the appointment was in the public interest.

items.citation_text: Order in Council 766/2025: termination of appointment
items.verbatim_snippet: Order in Council 766/2025 confirms that the same appointment remained valid until it was formally terminated on June 20, 2025.
